name: Sidebar Drawers and Page Content Test
description: Verifies that clicking Odadakiler opens the members drawer showing current user, clicking Sohbet opens the chat drawer, and clicking Sıra opens the queue drawer.

planSteps.description: Click the 'Odadakiler' button in the left sidebar
Verify that the Odadakiler drawer opens showing the connected users list with the current user labeled as 'Sen'
Click the close button on the Odadakiler drawer
Click the 'Sohbet' button in the left sidebar
Verify that the live chat drawer opens with the message input field and send button
Click the close button on the Sohbet drawer
Click the 'Sıra' button in the left sidebar
Verify that the playlist queue drawer opens
